subject: add generic function to pmml package

messages.author: ad4948885468e71d
messages.subject: add generic function to pmml package
parts:
I would like to propose to add just
this little S3 generic function to the
pmml package

pmml <- function(x, ...)
UseMethod("pmml")

This will allow one to simply export
any model using

pmml(modelobj)

Regards,
Tobias

P.S. Example:

library(pmml)
pmml <- function(x, ...)
UseMethod("pmml")
# kmeans example
x <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(100, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2), matrix(rnorm(100,
mean = 1, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2))
colnames(x) <- c("x", "y")
cl <- kmeans(x, 2)
pmml(cl)
# rpart example
fit <- rpart(Kyphosis ~ Age + Number + Start, data=kyphosis)
pmml(fit)
